The POCSO (Protection of Children from Sexual Offences) Act was enacted in **2012**. Key dates:
- Passed by the Rajya Sabha: 10 May 2012
- Passed by the Lok Sabha: 22 May 2012
- Received Presidential assent: 19 June 2012
- Officially commenced: 14 November 2012
